gitCommit.subject: fix(test): tolerate popup closing during the Submit click
gitCommit.body:
fix(test): tolerate popup closing during the Submit click

Submit runs window.close() in its onclick, so on slower runners the window closed while the click action was still finishing and Playwright raised 'Target page ... has been closed' (flaky on Chromium in CI). Ignore only that error; the close event is still awaited.
